description: wakewordlab 'hey jarvis' fronted by an external Silero pre-wake VAD gate (the plugin's own built-in VAD is disabled to avoid double-gating).
notes: Combo fighter: wake-word engine + pre-wake VAD. The plugin's own config.hotwords.hey_jarvis.vad is set to false and an external listener.VAD stage is used instead, so this gate is the same mechanism as the openWakeWord -silero combo fighters (vs. the bare wakewordlab-hey-jarvis fighter, which uses the plugin's built-in VAD gate).
